correctness.rationale: For cube unsigned incidence B, BB^T=2nI-L_Q and L_line=2nI-B^TB. With b supported on the two cube edges incident at zero, solve L_Q g=delta_e1-delta_e2 and obtain line-graph potential (b+B^Tg)/(2n). Heat kernel integration shows g levels h_j=int_0^(1/2) p^j(1-p)^(n-2-j) dp with strict order. Sum all adjacent edge gradients using binomial identities sum C(m,j)h_j=1/2, jh_(j-1)=3m/8, (m-j)h_(j+1)=m/8, j(m-j)(h_(j-1)-h_(j+1))=m(m-1)/4, plus the source-edge corrections. Cube edge transitivity reduces all line-graph projection columns to one. Complementary projector diagonal (N-1)/M gives cycle norm. Independently recomputed exact Laplacian-current representative columns for the full n=3,4 line graphs; both cut and cycle formulas agreed, including diagonal correction.
